# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 10 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 1 token.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--paper, #f0eee9);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--paper, #0a0b0a);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f0eee9;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--paper` | #f0eee9 | #0a0b0a | Page background of every chart, report and post. Warm paper in Paper theme, true terminal black in Terminal. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--panel, #e7e5df);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--panel, #141714);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #e7e5df;
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--panel` | #e7e5df | #141714 | Card / chart plate sitting on paper. Always with a 1px line border, never a shadow. |
| `--line` | #d6d3cc | #262b26 | Hairline borders on panels, gridlines in charts, dividers above the source footer. |
| `--signal` | #086f28 | #3bff4a | The one highlight per view: the key bar, the base-case number, the takeaway word, links. Readable as text on paper and panel in both themes (Paper ~5:1, Terminal ~14:1). |
| `--signal-tint` | #9fd9ac | #2e7a38 | Secondary bars and the context series behind a signal bar. Decorative only: always pair with a value label, never use as text. |
| `--phosphor` | #3bff4a | #3bff4a | The logo green. Fills on terminal black only: the logo, cover blocks, stickers, PFP rings. Never as text or a fill on paper. |
| `--terminal` | #000000 | #000000 | Logo ground and terminal-style blocks. Text on it is phosphor or ink in Terminal theme. |
| `--loss` | #b23a17 | #ff6a4d | Losses, drawdowns, rugs, and the second series when comparing against the signal series (e.g. NFTs vs memecoins). Darker than signal in Paper so the pair differs in lightness, not hue alone. |
| `--loss-tint` | #f1b9a6 | #5a2418 | Background zones for a drawdown phase in cycle diagrams. Decorative only. |
| `--caution` | #7e5700 | #f2c14e | Unconfirmed, speculative or 'not yet' labels: no token confirmed, forecast windows. Text-safe in both themes. |
| `--caution-tint` | #f3d98e | #4a3a12 | Background zone for the accumulation / no-one-cares phase and for 'not yet' shaded regions. Decorative only. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 400 96px/92px "Geist Pixel", "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-pixel-display);
font-family: var(--font-pixel);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pixel-display` | `.pixel-display`, `--text-pixel-display` | 96px / 92px | 400 | `pixel` | Brand name, cover, poster titles. |
| `headline` | `.headline`, `--text-headline` | 48px / 52px | 400 | `pixel` | Infographic headline: the takeaway sentence. |
| `stat` | `.stat`, `--text-stat` | 64px / 64px | 400 | `pixel` | Hero numbers. |
| `stat-sm` | `.stat-sm`, `--text-stat-sm` | 40px / 44px | 400 | `pixel` | Bar values, secondary numbers. |
| `pixel-stamp` | `.pixel-stamp`, `--text-pixel-stamp` | 20px / 24px | 400 | `pixel` | Stickers and stamps. |
| `grid-display` | `.grid-display`, `--text-grid-display` | 64px / 64px | 400 | `pixel-grid` | Decorative only: big background numerals, thumbnails, the Terminal face. Never for text people must read. |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/GeistPixel-Square.woff2` and `fonts/GeistPixel-Grid.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/GeistPixel-Square.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/GeistPixel-Square.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geist Pixel | `fonts/GeistPixel-Square.woff2` (weight 400) | `read fonts/GeistPixel-Square.woff2` | `var(--font-pixel)` | `geist-pixel` |
| Geist Pixel Grid | `fonts/GeistPixel-Grid.woff2` (weight 400) | `read fonts/GeistPixel-Grid.woff2` | `var(--font-pixel-grid)` | `geist-pixel-grid` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap, legend swatch gap. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Kicker to headline, stat to its label. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Rows inside a legend or key list. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Gap between sibling cards in a row. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Gap between stacked panels. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Panel inner padding. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Gap between header block and first panel. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Outer margin of a full infographic canvas. |
